opportunities.title: Regular Grants

amount.raw: Grants vary. Operating/core cost grants unlikely to fund more than 10% of an organisation's total annual budget; project grants tend to be 10-20% of total project cost; capital grants normally no more than 10% of total project cost, and for local community projects (e.g. village halls, community centres, places of worship) grants are likely to be no greater than £30,000 regardless of project size.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK registered charities, Charitable Incorporated Organisations (CIOs), and exempt/excepted organisations according to Charity Commission guidelines. Must have at least one year's worth of annual accounts as an eligible charity. Must work inside the UK or UKOTs. Only one application at a time; must wait a year after a previous application decision.
opportunities.summary: Rolling grants for UK charities towards operating/core costs, specific projects/activities, or capital projects (building works, repairs, or equipment). Applications are made via the online grants portal and reviewed in the order received.

opportunities.title: Major Grants

amount.raw: £100,000 and over. The total cost of what is being applied for must be at least £1 million.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: For core costs, the organisation's annual income must be £1 million or over. For capital or project costs, the organisation's income doesn't need to be over £1 million but the total cost of the project must be at least £1 million. Must be an eligible UK registered charity, CIO, or exempt/excepted organisation.
opportunities.summary: Major grants of £100,000 or more for core costs, capital projects, or specific projects where the total cost of what is being applied for is at least £1 million. Applicants complete a Major Grant Expression of Interest Form and receive bespoke guidance within 10 working days.
